label.fqdn_hint: This site's hosts: {{serverNames}}. List those that should go straight to SAML login, or leave empty to turn it off for this site.

samlLoginProvider.description: On the hosts of this site listed below, unauthenticated visitors are redirected to the SAML connect endpoint (/home.connect.saml) instead of the Jahia login page, and the logout button lands on a public page. On this site's other hosts, they get a login page offering both the credentials form and SAML sign-in.

disabled.hint: When the list is empty the module is inactive on this site: the standard Jahia login page is used.

samlLoginProvider.scope: This setting applies to the site {{siteKey}} only. Each site has its own list.
